phase: Final authorized score-free one-pair intake only; not full-study/scoring passage
eligibility: Original present comments, valid original integer UTC timestamp, declared corpus-level English assumption, frozen markdown preprocessing, usable body, >=20 retained word tokens. No per-record verified-English claim. Exclude source-account identities before preprocessing.
safe_metadata_prefilter: Preprocess all nonexcluded accounts with at least16 present timestamped original comments in each of at least2 communities across the entire archives. Accounts failing this necessary record-count condition cannot supply two cells of8 records. No raw-volume rank or style-based shortlist.
upper_bound: Count accounts with >=4000 eligible retained words and >=16 eligible records in each community over all observed dates. This is only a necessary condition for any two disjoint2000-word/eight-record periods, not feasible cell qualification.
date_choice: For each pair, prefer the scheme with most accounts meeting all4 cells; then smallest sum of squared differences between early and late calendar durations; then scheme id. Availability only. Keep all scheme results. If target fails, dates are proposals only.
disjoint_capacity: Enumerate all triples of even account quotas0..20 per pair and use exact account-to-stratum bipartite capacity matching. Maximize total blocks, then sorted ascending quota vector lexicographically (balanced leximin quotas), then quota tuple in sorted stratum order lexicographically. Report per-pair upper bounds separately from globally disjoint capacity. This produces a capacity witness, not a final cohort.
source_and_exclusion_audit: Fresh ZIP hashes, utterance hashes/counts/date ranges/field availability/duplicate IDs. Prior source-account maps only, including paired reserve identifiers; exclude all pilot1 and pilot2 paired/chronological and private-export accounts. Record known earlier capacity inspection separately. Never load reserve writing or feature vectors for design.
gate: No distances, no style-profile generation for selection, no change search and no final cohort. If any required quota fails before contamination filtering, Gate A fails. Do not quietly reduce targets. Gate B registration and scoring are conditional on Gate A and complete leakage audits.
privacy: Only aggregate counts, code and archive hashes in repository. Original account IDs, record IDs and per-account metadata stay in separate private visualization storage. No prose exported by census. Hashes are not claimed to anonymize text. Existing archives have authorized local-use history; redistribution license not established.
strata_choice: One predeclared learnmath/math pair only; full study gate evaluated separately with two prior fixed strata
